title.ja: M COUNTDOWN デビューステージ

summary.ja: 初の音楽番組ステージとなったMnet『M COUNTDOWN』で「Attention」「Hype Boy」「Cookie」の3曲を披露した放送デビュー回。
summary.en: NewJeans' broadcast debut: their first music-show stage, on Mnet's M Countdown, with 'Attention', 'Hype Boy' and 'Cookie'.

detail.ja: NewJeansが初めて音楽番組のステージに立った放送デビュー回。披露したのは「Attention」「Hype Boy」「Cookie」の3曲で、いずれも8月1日発売のデビューミニアルバム『New Jeans』の収録曲。『M COUNTDOWN』は毎週木曜放送のMnetの音楽チャート番組で、この日が5人の放送デビューとなった。
detail.en: NewJeans' first music-show stage and broadcast debut. They performed 'Attention', 'Hype Boy' and 'Cookie', all from the debut EP New Jeans released on August 1. M Countdown is Mnet's weekly Thursday chart program, and this episode marked the five members' first television appearance.

editor_note: 公式動画: Mnet K-POP「[NewJeans - Attention] Hot Debut Stage | #엠카운트다운 EP.764 | Mnet 220804 방송」(2022-08-04); 関連3本をreference_urlsに記載

title.ja: ミュージックバンク デビューステージ

summary.ja: 前日の『M COUNTDOWN』に続く2つ目の音楽番組ステージとして、KBS『ミュージックバンク』でデビュー曲「Attention」を披露した初出演回。
summary.en: NewJeans' first Music Bank appearance, performing the debut single 'Attention' a day after their M Countdown debut.

detail.ja: KBS『ミュージックバンク』に初めて出演し、デビュー曲「Attention」を披露した。『ミュージックバンク』は毎週金曜の生放送音楽番組で、前日の『M COUNTDOWN』に続く2つ目の音楽番組ステージとなった。
detail.en: NewJeans' first appearance on KBS's Music Bank, performing the debut single 'Attention'. Music Bank is KBS's live Friday music program, and this was the group's second music-show stage, a day after M Countdown.

editor_note: 公式動画: KBS Kpop「Attention - 뉴진스(NewJeans) [뮤직뱅크/Music Bank] | KBS 220805 방송」(2022-08-05); 関連3本をreference_urlsに記載

title.ja: 人気歌謡 デビューステージ

summary.ja: SBS『人気歌謡』に初出演して「Attention」「Cookie」を披露し、デビュー週の音楽番組出演がこれで一巡した回。
summary.en: NewJeans' first Inkigayo stage, with 'Attention' and 'Cookie', completing their debut-week round of music shows.

detail.ja: SBSの日曜音楽番組『人気歌謡』に初出演し、「Attention」と「Cookie」の2曲を披露した。このステージで、デビュー週のMnet、KBS、SBSの音楽番組出演が一巡した。
detail.en: NewJeans' first appearance on SBS's Sunday music program Inkigayo, performing 'Attention' and 'Cookie'. With this stage they had appeared on the music programs of Mnet, KBS and SBS within their debut week.

summary.ja: デビューステージの1週間後、Mnet『M COUNTDOWN』2度目の出演で「Attention」1曲を披露したステージ。
summary.en: NewJeans' second M Countdown appearance, a week after the debut stage, performing 'Attention' alone.

detail.ja: デビューステージから1週間後、Mnet『M COUNTDOWN』に2度目の出演を果たし「Attention」を披露した。この週は「Attention」1曲のステージだった。
detail.en: NewJeans' second appearance on Mnet's M Countdown, one week after the debut stage, performing 'Attention'. That week's stage was a single song.

title.ja: ミュージックバンク「Hype Boy」

summary.ja: 音楽番組で「Hype Boy」だけを歌う最初のステージとなった、KBS『ミュージックバンク』出演回。
summary.en: NewJeans performed 'Hype Boy' on Music Bank, the first music-show stage devoted to the song alone.

detail.ja: KBS『ミュージックバンク』で「Hype Boy」を披露した。デビューミニアルバム『New Jeans』の収録曲で、7月23日にミュージックビデオが公開されていた曲。音楽番組で「Hype Boy」だけを歌うステージはこの回が最初だった。
detail.en: NewJeans performed 'Hype Boy' on KBS's Music Bank. The track, from the debut EP New Jeans, had its music videos released on July 23, and this was the first music-show stage devoted to the song alone.

editor_note: 公式動画: KBS Kpop「Hype boy - 뉴진스(NewJeans) [뮤직뱅크/Music Bank] | KBS 220812 방송」(2022-08-12); 関連2本をreference_urlsに記載

title.ja: SBSラジオ『パク・ソヒョンのラブゲーム』
title.en: SBS Radio: Park So-hyun's Love Game

summary.ja: ミンジ、ダニエル、ヘリンの3人がSBSパワーFM『パク・ソヒョンのラブゲーム』に出演し、「今週の人気歌謡TOP10」コーナーに参加した。
summary.en: Minji, Danielle and Haerin appeared on SBS Power FM's Park So-hyun's Love Game, joining its weekly Inkigayo Top 10 segment.

detail.ja: ミンジ、ダニエル、ヘリンの3人がSBSパワーFM（107.7MHz）の『パク・ソヒョンのラブゲーム』に出演し、「今週の人気歌謡TOP10」コーナーに参加した。DJは俳優のパク・ソヒョンで、番組は毎日18時から20時の放送。この日は5人のうち3人での出演だった。
detail.en: Minji, Danielle and Haerin appeared on Park So-hyun's Love Game on SBS Power FM (107.7 MHz), joining its weekly Inkigayo Top 10 segment. The program, hosted by actress Park So-hyun, airs daily from 6 to 8 p.m. Three of the five members took part that day.

summary.en: NewJeans' second Inkigayo appearance, performing 'Attention' as a single-song stage.

detail.ja: SBS『人気歌謡』への2度目の出演で「Attention」を披露した。この週は「Attention」1曲だけのステージだった。
detail.en: NewJeans' second appearance on SBS's Inkigayo, performing 'Attention'. The stage that week consisted of the one song.

title.ja: SBSラジオ『2時脱出カルトショー』

summary.ja: 5人全員でのラジオ初出演となったSBSパワーFM『2時脱出カルトショー』。前日に続く2日連続のSBSラジオ出演。
summary.en: All five members on SBS Power FM's Cultwo Show, their first radio appearance as a full group and their second SBS radio slot in two days.

detail.ja: 5人全員がSBSパワーFM（107.7MHz）の『2時脱出カルトショー』（毎日14時〜16時）に出演した。グループ5人そろってのラジオ出演はこれが初めてで、「見るラジオ」として収録映像も公開された。放送前の8月11日には「Attention」「Hype Boy」のポイント振付の先行映像が公開されていた。前日の『パク・ソヒョンのラブゲーム』（3人出演）に続き、2日連続のSBSラジオ出演となった。
detail.en: All five members appeared on SBS Power FM (107.7MHz)'s Cultwo Show, broadcast daily from 2 to 4 p.m. It was the group's first radio appearance as a full five-member lineup, and the visible-radio footage was released. A preview clip of the point choreography for 'Attention' and 'Hype Boy' had been posted on August 11. Following Park So-hyun's Love Game the day before (with three members), it was the group's second SBS radio appearance in two days.

editor_note: Date and lineup per ja.wikipedia radio table; no contemporaneous article found for the broadcast content. / 公式動画: SBS Radio 에라오「[FULL][4K] The birth of the perfect "God-tier rookie" group you'll never get tired of! 💙NewJeans💙...」(2022-08-14); 関連1本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: SBS Radio 에라오 official YouTube: wf5bRNl24tY (Aug 14, 2022: 'first full-group radio appearance on Cultwo Show', 'August 14, 2022 During Broadcast', 'Every day 2 PM - 4 PM') and DEoh4Z4uH_0 (Aug 11, 2022 preview: '완전체 라디오 첫 출연', '8월 14일 일요일'). Fixed 'weekday public radio' (programme airs daily; 08-14 was a Sunday) and dropped the unconfirmed DJ credit (Kim Tae-gyun).

title.en: M Countdown: first win with Attention

summary.ja: Mnet『M COUNTDOWN』で「Attention」が少女時代「FOREVER 1」を抑え、デビュー約2週間で初の音楽番組1位を獲得。
summary.en: NewJeans' first music-show win: 'Attention' beat Girls' Generation's 'FOREVER 1' on M Countdown about two weeks after debut.

detail.ja: Mnet『M COUNTDOWN』で「Attention」が、もう1曲の1位候補だった少女時代「FOREVER 1」を抑えて1位を獲得した。デビューから約2週間での初の音楽番組1位。この週は夏季特集で生放送がなく、受賞コメントは映像で届けた。
detail.en: 'Attention' won first place on Mnet's M Countdown over the other nominee, Girls' Generation's 'FOREVER 1', giving NewJeans their first music-show trophy about two weeks after debut. The episode was a summer special without a live broadcast, so the group delivered their acceptance message in a video.

editor_note: Nominees and no-live-broadcast detail per Soompi (Aug 18, 2022) and OSEN. / 公式YouTube動画なし: NewJeans did not attend; Mnet K-POP has no clip for the 220818 win (only 220811/220825 stages)

title.ja: ミュージックバンク「Attention」1位

summary.ja: KBS『ミュージックバンク』で「Attention」が1位を獲得し、前日の『M COUNTDOWN』に続く2つ目のトロフィーとなった。
summary.en: 'Attention' took first place on KBS's Music Bank, NewJeans' second trophy after M Countdown the day before; they performed 'Hype Boy' and 'Hurt'.

detail.ja: KBS『ミュージックバンク』で「Attention」が1位を獲得した。前日の『M COUNTDOWN』に続く2つ目のトロフィーで、地上波の音楽番組では初の1位。この回のステージでは「Hype Boy」と「Hurt」を披露し、1位のアンコールでは「Attention」を歌った。
detail.en: 'Attention' won first place on KBS's Music Bank. It was NewJeans' second trophy, a day after M Countdown, and their first win on a terrestrial-TV music show. On the episode they performed 'Hype Boy' and 'Hurt', and sang 'Attention' for the winner's encore.

summary.en: 'Attention' won Show! Music Core, NewJeans' third music-show win in three days.

detail.ja: MBC『ショー！音楽中心』で「Attention」が1位を獲得した。『M COUNTDOWN』『ミュージックバンク』に続く3日連続の1位で、この番組では初のトロフィーだった。
detail.en: 'Attention' took first place on MBC's Show! Music Core, NewJeans' first trophy on that program and their third win in three days after M Countdown and Music Bank.

summary.ja: SBS『人気歌謡』で「Attention」が1位を獲得し、地上波3局とMnetの音楽番組すべてで1位を達成した回。
summary.en: 'Attention' won Inkigayo, completing wins on all four major music shows; NewJeans performed 'Hype Boy'.

detail.ja: SBS『人気歌謡』で「Attention」が1位を獲得した。これで『M COUNTDOWN』『ミュージックバンク』『ショー！音楽中心』と合わせ、地上波3局とMnetの音楽番組すべてで1位を獲得したことになる。この回では「Hype Boy」を披露し、1位のアンコールでは「Attention」を歌った。
detail.en: 'Attention' won first place on SBS's Inkigayo. With this win NewJeans had topped M Countdown, Music Bank, Show! Music Core and Inkigayo. They performed 'Hype Boy' on the episode and sang 'Attention' for the winner's encore.

summary.en: NewJeans performed 'Hype Boy' on M Countdown, the week after 'Attention' won the program.

detail.ja: Mnet『M COUNTDOWN』で「Hype Boy」を披露した。前週に「Attention」で1位を獲得した番組への続けての出演で、この週は「Hype Boy」のステージだった。
detail.en: NewJeans performed 'Hype Boy' on Mnet's M Countdown. It was the week after 'Attention' had won first place on the program.

summary.ja: KBS『ミュージックバンク』でデビューミニアルバム収録曲「Hurt」を披露した、音楽番組で同曲だけを歌う最初のステージ。
summary.en: NewJeans performed 'Hurt' on Music Bank, the first music-show stage devoted to the song alone.

detail.ja: KBS『ミュージックバンク』でデビューミニアルバム収録曲「Hurt」を披露した。ミュージックビデオは7月25日に公開されており、音楽番組で「Hurt」だけを歌うステージはこの回が最初だった。
detail.en: NewJeans performed 'Hurt', a track from the debut EP, on KBS's Music Bank. The song's music video had been released on July 25, and this was the first music-show stage devoted to it alone.

editor_note: 公式動画: KBS Kpop「Hurt - 뉴진스(NewJeans) [뮤직뱅크/Music Bank] | KBS 220826 방송」(2022-08-26); 関連3本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: KBS Kpop公式動画「Hurt - 뉴진스(NewJeans) [뮤직뱅크/Music Bank] | KBS 220826 방송」(2022-08-26 KST)で放送日と曲を確認。HYBE LABELSの「Hurt」MVは2022-07-25（KST）。前日8/25のMカウントダウンは「Hype Boy」で、それ以前の「Hurt」音楽番組ステージは見つからなかった。

summary.ja: SBS『人気歌謡』で「Attention」が2週連続1位となり、デビュー活動最終週に「Hurt」を披露して通算5冠に。
summary.en: 'Attention' took a second straight Inkigayo win, its fifth trophy, as NewJeans performed 'Hurt' in the final week of debut promotions.

detail.ja: SBS『人気歌謡』で「Attention」が前週に続き2週連続で1位を獲得した。デビュー活動4週目の最終週で、この回では「Hurt」を披露した。「Attention」の音楽番組1位はこれで通算5回となった。
detail.en: 'Attention' won first place on SBS's Inkigayo for a second consecutive week. The episode fell in the fourth and final week of debut promotions, and NewJeans performed 'Hurt'. The win brought the song's music-show total to five trophies.

summary.en: NewJeans performed 'Attention' as a congratulatory stage at the 49th Korea Broadcasting Awards, broadcast on KBS.

detail.ja: 韓国放送協会が主催する第49回韓国放送大賞の授賞式に出演し、祝賀公演として「Attention」を披露した。授賞式はKBSで放送された。
detail.en: NewJeans appeared at the 49th Korea Broadcasting Awards, organized by the Korean Broadcasters Association, and performed 'Attention' as a congratulatory stage. The ceremony was broadcast on KBS.

summary.ja: KSPO DOMEでの『2022 THE FACT MUSIC AWARDS』でネクストリーダー賞を受賞し、「Hype Boy」「Attention」を披露。
summary.en: NewJeans received the Next Leader Award at the 2022 The Fact Music Awards and performed 'Hype Boy' and 'Attention'.

detail.ja: ソウル・オリンピック公園のKSPO DOMEで開かれた『2022 THE FACT MUSIC AWARDS』でネクストリーダー賞を受賞した。ザ・ファクトが主催し、Circle Chartのデータと審査、ファン投票で選定される賞。ステージではイントロに続いて「Hype Boy」「Attention」を披露した。ファンNスター選択賞、フォースター賞、アイドルプラス人気賞にもノミネートされていた。
detail.en: NewJeans received the Next Leader Award at the 2022 The Fact Music Awards, held at KSPO Dome in Seoul's Olympic Park. The ceremony is organized by The Fact and judged on Circle Chart data, a panel and fan voting. The group performed an intro followed by 'Hype Boy' and 'Attention', and was also nominated for the Fan N Star Choice, Four Star and Idolplus Popularity awards.

summary.ja: 釜山広域市と釜山観光公社が製作し、5人がQRコードを手がかりに釜山を巡る全3話のトラベルリアリティ番組の第1話。
summary.en: First episode of a three-part SBS travel reality series in which the five members explore Busan guided by QR codes.

editor_note: Aired Oct 16 - Nov 6, 2022 (end date removed from the reader-facing summary). / 公式動画: SBS Entertainment「‘부산 구경도 식후경’ 뉴진스, 국밥집으로 이동 중에도 차 안에서 해피 에너지 뿜뿜★ | SBS 221016 방송 #뉴진스코드in부산 #newjeanscode #SBSenter」(2022-10-16); 関連4本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: SBS公式の予告動画（2022-10-14、「10월 16일 [일] 밤 12시 5분 첫 방송」）とSBS Entertainment公式クリップ（「SBS 221016 방송」「밤 12시 05분 본방송」）で放送日と時刻を確認。旧本文の「12時10分」は誤り（深夜0時5分、SBSの表記は16日放送）。製作・撮影日・スタッフはWikipediaによる。

detail.ja: 5人がQRコードを手がかりに松島スカイパーク、富平カントン市場、太宗台、多大浦海水浴場などを巡る全3話のトラベルリアリティ番組で、第1話「NewJeansと釜山で会いましょう！」がSBSで10月16日（日）の深夜0時5分（KST）から放送された。釜山広域市と釜山観光公社が製作し、撮影は9月26日と27日に釜山で行われた。製作総括はソン・ギフン、演出はユ・ギョンソクほか。配信はWavve。
detail.en: The first episode, 'See You in Busan with NewJeans!', of a three-episode travel reality series in which the five members tour Songdo Sky Park, Bupyeong Kkangtong Market, Taejongdae and Dadaepo Beach guided by QR codes. Produced by Busan Metropolitan City and the Busan Tourism Organization, it aired on SBS in the late-night slot of Sunday, October 16, from 12:05 a.m. KST. It was filmed in Busan on September 26 and 27. Seong Ki-hun was executive producer, Yoo Gyeong-seok among the directors, and the series streamed on Wavve.

credits.producer: Busan Metropolitan City / Busan Tourism Organization
credits.director: Yoo Gyeong-seok, Eom Jin-yong, Kim Na-yeon, Han Seon-woo

summary.ja: KBSホールでの第43回青龍映画賞で、祝賀公演の1番手として「Hype Boy」「Attention」を披露。
summary.en: NewJeans opened the performances at the 43rd Blue Dragon Film Awards with 'Hype Boy' and 'Attention'.

detail.ja: ソウル汝矣島のKBSホールで開かれた第43回青龍映画賞の授賞式で、祝賀公演の1番手として「Hype Boy」「Attention」を披露した。司会はキム・ヘスとユ・ヨンソク。KBS 2TVが生中継し、YouTubeとNAVER NOWでも配信された。
detail.en: NewJeans opened the performances at the 43rd Blue Dragon Film Awards at KBS Hall in Yeouido, Seoul, with 'Hype Boy' followed by 'Attention'. Hosted by Kim Hye-soo and Yoo Yeon-seok, the ceremony was broadcast live on KBS2 and streamed on YouTube and Naver Now.

editor_note: 公式動画: KBS Entertain「뉴진스, ‘Hype boy & Attention’ 축하공연 [제43회 청룡영화상 시상식] | KBS 221125 방송」(2022-11-25) / 2026-10-24 nightly: KBS Entertain公式動画「뉴진스, 'Hype boy & Attention' 축하공연 [제43회 청룡영화상 시상식] | KBS 221125 방송」（2022-11-25 KST、タグに김혜수・유연석）で祝賀公演と司会を確認。会場KBSホールと「1番手」は一次ソースで未再確認。

summary.ja: 『Melon Music Awards 2022』で新人賞とTOP10を受賞し、「Cookie」「Hype Boy」「Attention」を披露。
summary.en: NewJeans won Best New Artist and a Top 10 bonsang at the 2022 Melon Music Awards, performing 'Cookie', 'Hype Boy' and 'Attention'.

detail.ja: ソウルの高尺スカイドームで開かれた『Melon Music Awards 2022』で、新人賞（IVEと同時受賞）とTOP10（本賞）を受賞した。年間アルバム賞（デビューミニアルバム『New Jeans』）と女性グループ賞にもノミネート。「We Are <NewJeans>」と題したステージでは「Cookie」「Hype Boy」「Attention」を披露した。授賞式はMelon、KakaoTV、Wavve、1theKのYouTubeなどで配信された。
detail.en: At the 2022 Melon Music Awards at Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul, NewJeans won Best New Artist (shared with Ive) and a Top 10 Artists bonsang, with further nominations for Album of the Year (New Jeans) and Best Female Group. Their stage, titled 'We Are <NewJeans>', consisted of 'Cookie', 'Hype Boy' and 'Attention'. The show streamed on Melon, KakaoTV, Wavve and the 1theK YouTube channel.

editor_note: 公式動画: Melon「[MMA2022 | 축하공연] NewJeans(뉴진스) - Hype Boy | #NewJeans #뉴진스」(2022-11-27); 関連5本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: Melon's own YouTube uploads (TOP10 and Best New Artist IVE/NewJeans acceptance speeches, Hype Boy stage) and Newsis (2022-11-26: held 26th from 18:00 at Gocheok Sky Dome; co-Best New Artist with IVE; TOP 10) confirm date and awards; songs consistent with the official 2022 MMA Dance Practice (Cookie+Hype Boy+Attention). Stage title, the two other nominations and streaming outlets not separately confirmed.

summary.ja: 『2022 MAMA AWARDS』初日、IVE・Kep1er・NMIXX・LE SSERAFIMとメンバーを入れ替えて歌う合同ステージに参加。
summary.en: On day one of the 2022 MAMA Awards in Osaka, NewJeans joined a member-swapping collaboration stage with Ive, Kep1er, Nmixx and Le Sserafim.

detail.ja: 京セラドーム大阪で開かれた『2022 MAMA AWARDS』初日、IVE、Kep1er、NMIXX、LE SSERAFIMとの合同ステージ「LINNK the Next Generation」に参加した。各グループの曲をメンバーを入れ替えて歌うコラボで、ダニエルは「ELEVEN」、ハニは「WA DA DA」、ミンジは「O.O」、ヘインは「FEARLESS」、ヘリンは「Hype Boy」のパートを担当した。初日の司会はチョン・ソミで、Mnetが生中継した。
detail.en: On day one of the 2022 MAMA Awards at Kyocera Dome Osaka, NewJeans took part in the collaboration stage 'LINNK the Next Generation' with Ive, Kep1er, Nmixx and Le Sserafim. Members were mixed across each group's songs: Danielle sang on 'ELEVEN', Hanni on 'WA DA DA', Minji on 'O.O', Hyein on 'FEARLESS' and Haerin on 'Hype Boy'. Jeon Somi hosted day one, which Mnet broadcast live.

editor_note: 公式動画: Mnet K-POP「[2022 MAMA] IVE&Kep1er&NMIXX&LE SSERAFIM&NewJeans - CHEER UP | Mnet 221129 방송」(2022-11-29); 関連1本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: Mnet K-POP uploads labelled 'Mnet 221129 방송' confirm the broadcast date and the 'LINNK the next generation' stage with IVE, Kep1er, NMIXX, LE SSERAFIM (ELEVEN+WADADA+O.O+FEARLESS+Hype boy; CHEER UP). Host not separately confirmed.

summary.ja: 『2022 MAMA AWARDS』2日目、「NewFriends」と題したステージでイントロメドレーに続き「Hype Boy」「Attention」を披露。
summary.en: On day two of the 2022 MAMA Awards, NewJeans performed the 'NewFriends' stage: an intro medley, then 'Hype Boy' and 'Attention'.

detail.ja: 京セラドーム大阪での『2022 MAMA AWARDS』2日目に出演し、「NewFriends」と題したステージで「Cookie」「Attention」「Hurt」「Hype Boy（MAMA ver.）」のイントロメドレーに続き「Hype Boy」「Attention」を披露した。年間楽曲賞（「Attention」）、ベストダンスパフォーマンス女性グループ、ベスト新人女性アーティストなどにノミネートされたが受賞はなく、プロデューサーのミン・ヒジンがブレイクアウトプロデューサー賞を受けた。司会はパク・ボゴム。
detail.en: On day two of the 2022 MAMA Awards at Kyocera Dome Osaka, NewJeans performed a stage titled 'NewFriends': an intro medley of 'Cookie', 'Attention', 'Hurt' and 'Hype Boy' (MAMA version), followed by 'Hype Boy' and 'Attention'. The group was nominated for Song of the Year ('Attention'), Best Dance Performance Female Group and Best New Female Artist without winning, while producer Min Hee-jin received the Breakout Producer award. Park Bo-gum hosted.

editor_note: 公式動画: Mnet K-POP「[2022 MAMA] NewJeans - Cookie+Attention+Hurt+Hype boy (MAMA ver.) | Mnet 221130 방송」(2022-11-30); 関連5本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: Mnet K-POP uploads labelled 'Mnet 221130 방송' confirm the 'NewFriends' stage (Cookie+Attention+Hurt+Hype boy MAMA ver.; Attention) and red carpet. Nominations, Min Hee-jin's award and host not separately confirmed.

summary.ja: 名古屋の日本ガイシホールでの『2022 Asia Artist Awards』で新人賞と大賞の今年のパフォーマンス賞を受賞し、「Attention」を披露。
summary.en: NewJeans won Rookie of the Year and the Performance of the Year Daesang at the 2022 Asia Artist Awards in Nagoya, performing 'Attention'.

detail.ja: 名古屋の日本ガイシホールで開かれた『2022 Asia Artist Awards』で、新人賞（音楽部門）と、大賞である今年のパフォーマンス賞を受賞した。ステージでは「Attention」を披露。司会はチャン・ウォニョンとイトゥクで、Star Live OnとKAVECONで配信された。
detail.en: At the 2022 Asia Artist Awards at Nippon Gaishi Hall in Nagoya, NewJeans received Rookie of the Year (Music) and the Performance of the Year grand prize (Daesang), and performed 'Attention'. Jang Won-young and Leeteuk hosted, and the show was streamed on Star Live On and KAVECON.

editor_note: 公式動画: 스타뉴스 STARNEWS「[AAA직캠] 뉴진스 (NewJeans) ‘Intro+Attention’ 4K (NewJeans Fancam)」(2022-12-13); 関連5本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: organiser Star News's YouTube (descriptions: held 13th at Nippon Gaishi Hall, Nagoya; Rookie of the Year and Performance of the Year acceptance speeches; 'Intro+Attention' stage) confirms date, venue and awards. Hosts and streaming outlets not separately confirmed.

summary.en: All five members on tvN's You Quiz on the Block, talking about their pre-debut preparation and the making of the album.

editor_note: Date from ja.wikipedia; not confirmed on tvN's site. | Air date confirmed by Kuki News (Dec 15, 2022) ratings report; episode number not confirmed (likely ep. 172). / 公式動画: tvN Joy「'우리 모두 버니스' 2년 전부터 연습한 어텐션이 세상에 공개되기까지!#유퀴즈온더블럭 | YOU QUIZ ON THE BLOCK EP.172 | tvN 221214 방송」(2022-12-15); 関連6本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: tvN Joy official clip titled 'YOU QUIZ ON THE BLOCK EP.172 | tvN 221214 방송' confirms the air date and episode 172.

detail.ja: tvNのトーク番組『ユ・クイズ ON THE BLOCK』に5人で出演し、デビュー準備の過程やアルバム制作の裏話を語った。同じ回にはソン・フンミン選手の父ソン・ウンジョン監督らも出演。ニールセン・コリア基準の全国有料世帯視聴率は6.6%で、前回放送から1.3ポイント上昇した。
detail.en: All five members appeared on tvN's talk show You Quiz on the Block, discussing their pre-debut preparation and the stories behind making the album. The same episode featured Son Woong-jung, father of footballer Son Heung-min. It recorded a 6.6 percent nationwide paid-household rating (Nielsen Korea), up 1.3 points from the previous week.

summary.ja: 『2022 KBS歌謡大祝祭』で「Attention」「Hype Boy」を披露し、ミンジとヘインはプロジェクトユニットAkizでSHINeeをカバー。
summary.en: NewJeans performed 'Attention' and 'Hype Boy' at the 2022 KBS Song Festival, while Minji and Hyein covered Shinee as the project unit Akiz.

detail.ja: ソウルの蚕室室内体育館で開かれた『2022 KBS歌謡大祝祭』に出演し、第1部の最後に「Attention」「Hype Boy」を披露した。ミンジとヘインはNMIXXのソリュン、IVEのイソ、LE SSERAFIMのホン・ウンチェとのプロジェクトユニット「Akiz」として、SHINee「酸素のような君（Love Like Oxygen）」をカバーした。番組はY2Kをテーマに構成され、KBS 2TVが20時30分から生中継。司会はナ・イヌ、チャン・ウォニョン、キム・シニョン。
detail.en: NewJeans closed Part 1 of the 2022 KBS Song Festival at Jamsil Arena in Seoul with 'Attention' and 'Hype Boy'. Minji and Hyein also joined Sullyoon (Nmixx), Leeseo (Ive) and Hong Eun-chae (Le Sserafim) as the project unit 'Akiz' for a cover of Shinee's 'Love Like Oxygen'. Built around a Y2K theme, the show was broadcast live on KBS 2TV from 8:30 pm KST, hosted by Na In-woo, Jang Won-young and Kim Shin-young.

credits.host: Na In-woo, Jang Won-young, Kim Shin-young

editor_note: 公式動画: KBS Kpop「뉴진스 (NewJeans) - Intro + Attention + Hype boy [2022 KBS 가요대축제] | KBS 221216 방송」(2022-12-16); 関連5本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: KBS Kpop official upload 'Intro + Attention + Hype boy [2022 KBS 가요대축제] | KBS 221216 방송' confirms the broadcast date and songs. Akiz unit, hosts and director not separately confirmed.

summary.ja: SBSプリズムタワーでの『2022 SBS芸能大賞』で、『ゴール打つ女』のFCバラドリームと共に「Attention」を祝賀公演として披露。
summary.en: NewJeans performed 'Attention' at the 2022 SBS Entertainment Awards, joined on stage by FC Balladream from Kick a Goal.

detail.ja: ソウル上岩のSBSプリズムタワーで開かれた『2022 SBS芸能大賞』で、祝賀公演として「Attention」を披露した。ステージにはSBS『ゴール打つ女』のチーム「FCバラドリーム」が加わった。
detail.en: NewJeans performed 'Attention' as a celebratory stage at the 2022 SBS Entertainment Awards at SBS Prism Tower in Sangam, Seoul. They were joined by FC Balladream, the team from SBS's Kick a Goal (Gol-ttaerineun Geunyeodeul).

editor_note: Venue and collaboration per en.wikipedia live-performance list; no press article fetched. / 公式動画: SBS Entertainment「뉴진스×FC발라드림이 함께하는 초특급 콜라보 축하 무대! ＜Attention♪＞ #2022SBS연예대상 #SBSenter」(2022-12-17) / 2026-10-24 nightly: SBS Entertainment official YouTube clip (2022-12-17 KST, 'broadcast 12-17 20:35') and SBS Entertainment News (2022-12-18 00:07) confirm the live broadcast from SBS Prism Tower, Sangam, and the 'Attention' collaboration with FC Balladream.

summary.ja: 高尺スカイドームでの『2022 SBS歌謡大典』で、第1部に「Attention」、第3部にWonder Girls「Tell Me」のリミックスカバーを披露。
summary.en: At the 2022 SBS Gayo Daejeon, NewJeans performed 'Attention' in Part 1 and a remixed cover of Wonder Girls' 'Tell Me' in Part 3.

detail.ja: ソウルの高尺スカイドームで開かれた『2022 SBS歌謡大典』に出演し、第1部で「Attention」を披露、第3部ではWonder Girls「Tell Me」のリミックスをカバーした。SBSが19時30分から生中継。司会はSHINeeのキー、ASTROのチャ・ウヌ、IVEのアン・ユジン。
detail.en: At the 2022 SBS Gayo Daejeon at Gocheok Sky Dome in Seoul, NewJeans performed 'Attention' in Part 1 and a remixed cover of Wonder Girls' 'Tell Me' in Part 3. SBS broadcast the show live from 7:30 pm KST, with Key (Shinee), Cha Eun-woo (Astro) and An Yu-jin (Ive) hosting.

summary.ja: 日本テレビ系の年間ミュージックアワード特番で「Attention」を披露した、日本のテレビでの初パフォーマンス。
summary.en: NewJeans' first performance on Japanese television: 'Attention' on Nippon TV's year-end music award special.

detail.ja: ホテルニューオータニ幕張から19時に日本テレビ系で生放送された『発表！今年イチバン聴いた歌～年間ミュージックアワード2022～』に出演し、「Attention」を披露した。ストリーミングデータをもとにApple Musicの2022年トップソング100を発表する番組で、NewJeansにとって日本のテレビでの初パフォーマンスだった。
detail.en: NewJeans performed 'Attention' on Nippon TV's year-end special Happyo! Kotoshi Ichiban Kiita Uta: Nenkan Music Award 2022, broadcast live from 7 pm from Hotel New Otani Makuhari. The program counts down Apple Music's top 100 songs of 2022 based on streaming data, and this was the group's first performance on Japanese television.

title.ja: SBSラジオ『チェ・ファジョンのパワータイム』
title.en: SBS Radio: Choi Hwa-jung's Power Time

summary.ja: 『OMG』発売翌日にSBSパワーFM『チェ・ファジョンのパワータイム』へ5人で出演し、反響の実感やMVの解釈、初精算の使い道を語った。
summary.en: All five members on Choi Hwa-jung's Power Time the day after OMG's release, talking about their reception, the music video and their first earnings.

detail.ja: 前日に発売したシングルアルバム『OMG』の宣伝として、5人全員がSBSパワーFM『チェ・ファジョンのパワータイム』に午後出演した。DJチェ・ファジョンの質問に、メンバーはデビュー後の反響を予想していなかったと答え、ヘインは「OMG」のミュージックビデオの意味の解釈は視聴者に委ねたいと述べた。ほかに「Hype Boy」チャレンジへの反応や1位公約、初精算の使い道などが話題になった。
detail.en: All five members appeared on Choi Hwa-jung's Power Time on SBS Power FM in the afternoon to promote the single album OMG, released the day before. Asked by DJ Choi Hwa-jung whether they had expected their reception, the members said they had not, and Hyein said the group wanted to leave the meaning of the 'OMG' music video open to viewers. Other topics included fan 'Hype Boy' challenge videos, a first-place pledge and how they spent their first earnings.

title.ja: 第37回ゴールデンディスクアワード

summary.ja: バンコクの第37回ゴールデンディスクアワードで新人賞とデジタル音源部門本賞を受賞し、オープニングで「OMG」を初披露。
summary.en: NewJeans won Rookie of the Year and a Digital Song Bonsang at the 37th Golden Disc Awards in Bangkok, opening the show with the first-ever performance of 'OMG'.

detail.ja: タイ・バンコクのラジャマンガラ・スタジアムで開かれた第37回ゴールデンディスクアワードで、新人賞（IVE、LE SSERAFIMと同時受賞）とデジタル音源部門本賞（「Attention」）を受賞した。「Attention」はデジタル音源大賞にもノミネートされていた。オープニングの1番手として、チアリーディング風のイントロ、新アレンジの「Attention（Golden Disc ver.）」「Hype Boy」、初披露となる「OMG」を続けて披露した。司会はソン・シギョン、イ・ダヒ、ニックン、パク・ソダム。韓国ではJTBC、日本ではTBSとParaviで放送・配信された。
detail.en: At the 37th Golden Disc Awards at Rajamangala Stadium in Bangkok, NewJeans won Rookie Artist of the Year (shared with Ive and Le Sserafim) and a Digital Song Bonsang for 'Attention', which was also nominated for the Digital Daesang. Opening the show, they performed a cheerleading-style intro, a newly arranged Golden Disc version of 'Attention', 'Hype Boy' and the first-ever performance of 'OMG'. Sung Si-kyung, Lee Da-hee, Nichkhun and Park So-dam hosted, and the ceremony aired on JTBC in Korea and on TBS and Paravi in Japan.

title.ja: SBSラジオ『2時脱出カルトショー』

summary.ja: 5人でSBSパワーFM『2時脱出カルトショー』に出演し、「Ditto」のハミングの録音秘話やビルボードHot 100入りの感想を語った。
summary.en: All five members on the Cultwo Show, sharing how the 'Ditto' humming was recorded and their thoughts on entering the Billboard Hot 100.

detail.ja: 5人全員でSBSパワーFM『2時脱出カルトショー』に出演した。スペシャルDJは歌手のファン・チヨル、進行はキム・テギュン。人気を実感する瞬間を問われ、ダニエルはまだ実感がないと答え、ミンジは「Ditto」が公開2時間でチャート1位になったことに触れた。ヘインは「Ditto」のハミングを自身が録音したと明かし、ダニエルはガイド音源なしで録音していると語った。ほかにビルボードHot 100入りの感想、初精算での家族への贈り物、旧正月の予定が話題になった。
detail.en: All five members appeared on SBS Power FM's Cultwo Show, with singer Hwang Chi-yeul as special DJ alongside host Kim Tae-gyun. Asked when they feel their popularity, Danielle said it still did not feel real, and Minji noted that 'Ditto' reached number one on a chart two hours after release. Hyein revealed she recorded the humming in 'Ditto' herself, and Danielle said the group records without vocal guides. They also discussed entering the Billboard Hot 100, gifts bought for family with their first earnings and their Lunar New Year plans.

summary.en: After Jang Won-young left, Minji hosted KBS's Music Bank as a special MC, her first time presenting a show.

detail.ja: 1月13日の放送を最後にIVEのチャン・ウォニョンがMCを降板し、ミンジがスペシャルMCとして穴を埋めた。番組ではチェ・ミンに「スペシャル銀行長」と紹介され、「Hype Boy」に合わせて踊りながらあいさつした。「進行は初めてで本当に緊張する。今日と来週の2週間、全力を尽くす」と語り、自作の掛け声も披露した。
detail.en: With Ive's Jang Won-young having left the show after the 13 January broadcast, Minji filled in as special MC. Introduced by co-host Choi Min as the 'special bank manager', she greeted viewers by dancing to 'Hype Boy'. She said it was her first time hosting and that she would do her best for two weeks, this week and next, and showed off a chant she had made up herself.

detail.en: At the Circle Chart Music Awards 2022 at KSPO Dome in Seoul's Olympic Park, NewJeans won New Artist of the Year (Digital) for 'Attention', while Ive took the album-category rookie award. detail.ja: 米シカゴのグラント・パークで開かれた『Lollapalooza 2023』初日、T-Mobileステージの17時台（現地時間）の枠に出演した。K-POPのガールグループとしてこのフェスティバル初の出演。フェスはHuluが8月3日から6日まで配信し、NewJeansの出演枠はHuluのチャンネル1で米東部時間18時05分に案内されていた。バンド編成の「Hype Boy」で始まり、「Cookie」「Hurt」「Attention」「Ditto」「OMG」「New Jeans」「Super Shy」「ETA」「Cool With You」「Get Up」「ASAP」まで計12曲を披露した。
detail.en: NewJeans played the 5 pm-hour slot (local time) on the T-Mobile Stage on day one of Lollapalooza 2023 in Grant Park, Chicago, the first K-pop girl group to perform at the festival. Hulu streamed the festival from August 3 to 6, with the NewJeans set listed on Hulu's Channel 1 at 6:05 pm ET. Opening with a band version of 'Hype Boy', they performed 12 songs: 'Hype Boy', 'Cookie', 'Hurt', 'Attention', 'Ditto', 'OMG', 'New Jeans', 'Super Shy', 'ETA', 'Cool With You', 'Get Up' and 'ASAP'.

detail.en: NewJeans' 'ETA' stage aired on KBS's Music Bank. Earlier the same day (Korean time) the group had performed at Lollapalooza in Chicago. KBS's official channels posted the broadcast stage and a one-take 'Bonus Ver.' clip.

summary.en: NewJeans received the K Global Best Music Award alongside (G)I-dle, aespa, Ive and Le Sserafim at the 2023 K Global Heart Dream Awards.

detail.ja: ソウル・オリンピック公園のKSPO DOMEで午後に開かれた『2023 K Global Heart Dream Awards』で、（G）I-DLE、aespa、IVE、LE SSERAFIMとともにKグローバルベスト音源賞を受賞した。受賞は前日の8月9日に主催側から事前発表されていた。司会はチョン・ヒョンムとチャン・ドヨンで、授賞式はOTTアプリとウェブサイトで世界に生配信された。
detail.en: NewJeans received the K Global Best Music Award alongside (G)I-dle, aespa, Ive and Le Sserafim at the 2023 K Global Heart Dream Awards, held in the afternoon at KSPO Dome in Seoul's Olympic Park. The award had been announced in advance on August 9. Jun Hyun-moo and Jang Do-yeon hosted, and the ceremony was streamed worldwide via an OTT app and website.

editor_note: Per OSEN (Aug 9, 2023); whether NewJeans attended or performed is not confirmed. / 公式YouTube動画なし: No official organizer/broadcaster clip found for the 2023 K-Global Heart Dream Awards / 2026-10-24 nightly: OSEN (2023-08-09 11:57 KST) confirms the organisers pre-announced on Aug 9 the K Global Best Music Award for (G)I-dle, aespa, IVE, LE SSERAFIM and NewJeans, with a written acceptance comment from NewJeans, ceremony Aug 10 afternoon at KSPO Dome, hosts Jun Hyun-moo and Jang Do-yeon; Xports News (2023-08-11) confirms the ceremony and the award. summary.ja: KBS 2TVが生中継した世界スカウトジャンボリー閉幕公演でヘインがMCを務め、NewJeansが「ETA」「Hype Boy」を披露。
summary.en: KBS 2TV aired the World Scout Jamboree closing concert live, with Hyein as co-MC and NewJeans performing 'ETA' and 'Hype Boy'.

detail.ja: ソウルワールドカップ競技場で開かれた第25回世界スカウトジャンボリーの閉幕公演『K-POPスーパーライブ』を、KBS 2TVとKBS WORLD TVのYouTubeチャンネルが19時から生中継した。この日の『ミュージックバンク』は休止となった。MCは俳優コン・ミョン、ITZYのユナ、NewJeansのヘインが務め、NewJeansは第1部の最後に「ETA」「Hype Boy」を披露した。
detail.en: KBS 2TV and the KBS WORLD TV YouTube channel broadcast live from 7 pm the closing concert of the 25th World Scout Jamboree, K-pop Super Live, at Seoul World Cup Stadium; Music Bank was cancelled that day. Actor Gong Myung, ITZY's Yuna and NewJeans' Hyein hosted, and NewJeans closed the first part with 'ETA' and 'Hype Boy'.

editor_note: Broadcast: Soompi (2023-08-11) — closing ceremony 5:30 pm KST, concert live from 7 pm on KBS2 and KBS WORLD TV YouTube. Hosts: NewDaily (2023-08-11) — Gong Myung, Yuna, Hyein. summary.ja: SBS『人気歌謡』で「Super Shy」がトリプルクラウンを達成し、「ASAP」を披露して『Get Up』活動を締めくくった回。
summary.en: 'Super Shy' completed an Inkigayo triple crown as NewJeans closed the Get Up promotions with 'ASAP'.

detail.ja: SBS『人気歌謡』で「Super Shy」が1位を獲得し、この番組でのトリプルクラウンを達成した。1位候補はSTAYC「Bubble」と、NewJeansの「Super Shy」「ETA」で、2位も「ETA」だった。『Get Up』活動の最終ステージで、この回は「ASAP」を披露した。
detail.en: 'Super Shy' won first place on SBS's Inkigayo, completing a triple crown on the program; the nominees were STAYC's 'Bubble' and NewJeans' 'Super Shy' and 'ETA', with 'ETA' in second. The episode was the group's final stage of the Get Up promotions, on which they performed 'ASAP'.

Score 7,211 per Inkigayo 2023 winners list, not added.

summary.ja: 『Get Up』活動終了後のSBS『人気歌謡』で「ETA」が6,572点で1位、同番組での同曲初のトロフィー。
summary.en: 'ETA' took its first Inkigayo trophy with 6,572 points after the Get Up promotions had ended.

detail.ja: SBS『人気歌謡』で「ETA」が6,572点で1位を獲得した。1位候補はパク・ジェジョン「Let's Say Goodbye」、LE SSERAFIM「Eve, Psyche & the Bluebeard's wife」と「ETA」。「Super Shy」がトリプルクラウンで候補から外れた直後の受賞で、「ETA」の『人気歌謡』での1位はこれが最初。NewJeansは8月27日で『Get Up』の活動を終えており、出演しなかった。
detail.en: 'ETA' won first place on SBS's Inkigayo with 6,572 points over Park Jae-jung's 'Let's Say Goodbye' and Le Sserafim's 'Eve, Psyche & the Bluebeard's wife', its first Inkigayo trophy. It came right after 'Super Shy' left the nominees on taking a triple crown. NewJeans, who had wrapped Get Up promotions on August 27, did not appear.

summary.en: NewJeans won Artist of the Year and Listener's Choice at the 2023 The Fact Music Awards in Incheon, performing 'Super Shy' and 'ETA'.

detail.ja: 仁川南洞体育館で開かれた『2023 THE FACT MUSIC AWARDS』で、今年のアーティスト（本賞）とListener's Choice賞を受賞した。授賞式は18時30分開始で、司会はチョン・ヒョンムとソヒョン。受賞コメントでは、いつ聴いても飽きない音楽で舞台に立たせてくれたとミン・ヒジン代表に感謝し、Bunniesにも謝意を述べた。ステージでは「Super Shy」と「ETA」を披露した。
detail.en: NewJeans received Artist of the Year (Bonsang) and the Listener's Choice Award at the 2023 The Fact Music Awards at Namdong Gymnasium in Incheon. The ceremony began at 6:30 pm, hosted by Jun Hyun-moo and Seohyun. In their acceptance speech they thanked CEO Min Hee-jin for letting them perform music that never gets old, and thanked Bunnies. The group performed 'Super Shy' and 'ETA'.

detail.ja: 『2023 Billboard Music Awards』で新設のTop Global K-Pop Artistを受賞した。この年の授賞式はテレビ放送ではなくオンライン（BBMAs.watch）で米東部時間19日20時から配信された。NewJeansは「Super Shy」と「OMG」のパフォーマンスを披露。ノミネートは計5部門で、Top K-Pop Album（『Get Up』）、Top Global K-Pop Song（「Ditto」「OMG」）、Top Billboard Global（Excl. U.S.）Artistにも名を連ねた。
detail.en: NewJeans won the newly created Top Global K-Pop Artist award at the 2023 Billboard Music Awards. That year's ceremony streamed online at BBMAs.watch from 8 pm ET on November 19 rather than airing on television. NewJeans performed 'Super Shy' and 'OMG'. They had five nominations in total, including Top K-Pop Album (Get Up), Top Global K-Pop Song ('Ditto' and 'OMG') and Top Billboard Global (Excl. U.S.) Artist.

detail.en: At the 2023 Melon Music Awards at Inspire Arena in Incheon, NewJeans won five awards: the Daesangs for Artist of the Year and Song of the Year ('Ditto'), plus Best Group (Female), Top 10 and Millions Top 10. Closing Part 1, they performed all six Get Up tracks in new arrangements and choreography: Haerin led 'New Jeans', Danielle 'Super Shy', Minji, Danielle and Hyein performed 'ETA' as a unit, Hanni led 'Cool With You', and all five performed 'Get Up' and 'ASAP'. In their speeches they thanked Bunnies. The show streamed on ABEMA in Japan and on Beyond LIVE outside Korea and Japan.

detail.ja: 東京・新国立劇場で開かれた『第65回輝く！日本レコード大賞』で、大賞候補となる優秀作品賞（「Ditto」）と特別賞を受賞した。両賞は11月22日に発表されており、所属事務所によれば海外アーティストが大賞候補に選ばれたのは初めて。ステージでは「Ditto」「ETA」「New Jeans」の3曲を披露した。TBS系で17時30分から22時まで生放送され、総合司会は安住紳一郎と川口春奈。
detail.en: At the 65th Japan Record Awards at the New National Theatre in Tokyo, NewJeans received an Excellent Work Award for 'Ditto', which made it a Grand Prix candidate, and a Special Award; both were announced on November 22, and according to their agency they were the first overseas act to be a Grand Prix candidate. They performed 'Ditto', 'ETA' and 'New Jeans'. TBS broadcast the ceremony live from 5:30 to 10:00 pm, hosted by Shinichiro Azumi and Haruna Kawaguchi.

detail.en: Billboard Women in Music 2024, held on March 6 at the YouTube Theater in Inglewood, California, was streamed on Billboard's website from 5 pm PT on March 7. NewJeans received Group of the Year from Lainey Wilson, the first K-pop act to win the award, and performed 'Super Shy' and 'ETA'. Karol G was that year's Woman of the Year.

detail.en: NewJeans appeared at the 2024 Korea on Stage – New Generation concert, held at 7:30 pm on a special stage in front of Heungnyemun Gate at Gyeongbokgung Palace in Seoul and aired on KBS 2TV that night. Hosted by the Korea Heritage Service and organized by the Korea Heritage Agency and KBS to mark the agency's launch, the show was emceed solely by Danielle. NewJeans presented a 'Cool With You' special stage pre-recorded at Geunjeongjeon Hall, the first K-pop girl group to perform there, and performed 'Ditto', 'ETA' and 'Super Shy' at the venue. Hyein, with an injury to her foot, did not take part, so four members appeared. KBS World carried the broadcast to 142 countries.

summary.en: NewJeans' first terrestrial variety appearance: Minji, Hanni, Danielle and Haerin guested on 2 Days & 1 Night's Cheorwon episode and played games against the cast.

detail.ja: KBS 2TV『1泊2日 シーズン4』の江原道鉄原郡編（第2話）に18時10分からゲスト出演した。地上波バラエティ番組への出演はこれが初めてで、足を負傷したヘインを除くミンジ、ハニ、ダニエル、ヘリンの4人が参加した。番組メンバーとの退勤をかけたゲーム対決では、「100秒ダンス」のラウンドでハニが97秒で鐘を鳴らしてNewJeansが勝利したが、最終ラウンドでナ・イヌが勝ち、番組側の総合勝利となった。ニールセン・コリア基準の全国視聴率は6.1%、瞬間最高は9.2%だった。
detail.en: NewJeans guested on KBS 2TV's 2 Days & 1 Night Season 4 in the second Cheorwon (Gangwon-do) episode, aired from 6:10 pm, their first appearance on a terrestrial variety show. Minji, Hanni, Danielle and Haerin took part, with Hyein absent due to a foot injury. In games against the cast for the right to go home, Hanni rang the bell at 97 seconds to win the 100-second dance round, but Na In-woo took the final round for the cast. The episode drew a 6.1 percent nationwide rating (Nielsen Korea) with a peak of 9.2 percent.

detail.en: NewJeans appeared on Fuji TV's morning information program Mezamashi 8, performing 'Bubble Gum' in the segment around 9:30 am. The song had been the program's theme since April 8, and this was its first performance on Japanese television. The appearance followed the group's slot on Mezamashi TV earlier the same morning.

detail.en: On the release day of their Japanese debut single Supernatural, NewJeans appeared live on Fuji TV's Mezamashi TV (5:25 to 8:00 am) and gave the world's first performance of the title track 'Supernatural'. The same day they also appeared on Mezamashi 8 and TV Asahi's Music Station.

Other acts that night included INI ('LOUD'), GLAY x JAY of ENHYPEN ('whodunit'), Travis Japan ('Sweetest Tune') and MY FIRST STORY x HYDE. detail.en: J-WAVE (81.3 FM)'s program SPARK aired a NewJeans feature at midnight. Tuesday navigator Kazuki Arai of King Gnu, who played bass at the group's Tokyo Dome shows, visited the members in the rehearsal dressing room at Tokyo Dome, and the roundtable talk he recorded there formed the broadcast.

summary.en: Live in the studio at Fuji TV's 2024 FNS Music Festival Summer, NewJeans performed a medley of 'ETA', 'OMG' and 'Supernatural'.

detail.ja: 18時30分からフジテレビ系で生放送された『2024 FNS歌謡祭 夏』にスタジオ生出演し、「ETA」「OMG」「Supernatural」のスペシャルメドレーを披露した。司会は相葉雅紀と井上清華アナウンサー。NewJeansが『FNS歌謡祭』のスタジオに登場するのはこれが初めてだった。足の負傷で療養中のヘインは出演せず、4人でのステージだった。
detail.en: NewJeans appeared live in the studio on Fuji TV's 2024 FNS Music Festival Summer, broadcast from 6:30 pm, performing a special medley of 'ETA', 'OMG' and 'Supernatural'. Masaki Aiba and announcer Sayaka Inoue hosted, and it was the group's first time in the FNS Music Festival studio. Hyein, recovering from a foot injury, did not appear, so four members performed.

detail.en: As the final installment of WOWOW's NewJeans feature, a NewJeans Music Video Collection was broadcast and streamed in November. A rebroadcast of the Tokyo Dome fan meeting was scheduled the same month.

summary.ja: 日本テレビ『with MUSIC』に3度目の出演で「OMG」を披露、いきものがかりやOmoinotakeらと共演。
summary.en: NewJeans' third with MUSIC appearance, performing 'OMG' alongside Ikimonogakari and Omoinotake.

detail.ja: 日本テレビ系『with MUSIC』に出演し、「OMG」を披露した。この番組3度目の出演で、この回にはいきものがかり、Omoinotake、松下洸平、wacciが出演した。
detail.en: NewJeans made their third appearance on Nippon TV's with MUSIC, performing 'OMG'. The episode also featured Ikimonogakari, Omoinotake, Kohei Matsushita and wacci.

editor_note: 公式YouTube動画なし: NTV does not publish with MUSIC performances on YouTube; no official upload found / 2026-10-24 nightly: Official @NewJeans_jp X post (fxtwitter, 2024-11-09 21:00 JST, #withMUSIC) confirms the appearance. CINRA's program listing (via Excite) gives the 2024-11-09 19:56 broadcast with NewJeans performing 'OMG' alongside Ikimonogakari, Omoinotake, wacci and Kohei Matsushita (who also performed, besides being the regular navigator).

summary.ja: 二宮和也の『ニノさん』の金曜枠初の2時間SPにゲスト出演し、日本のバラエティ番組に初めて出演した。
summary.en: NewJeans made their first Japanese variety-show appearance as guests on the first two-hour special of Nino-san in its Friday slot.

detail.ja: 日本テレビ系で19時から20時54分に放送された、二宮和也がMCを務めるバラエティ番組『ニノさん』の金曜よる枠初の2時間SPにゲスト出演した。日本のバラエティ番組への出演はこれが初めてで、NewJeansのブロックには有岡大貴（Hey! Say! JUMP）とヒコロヒーが加わった。メンバーそれぞれの特技の披露、街の人の質問に答える「カプセルトーク」、「NewJeans VSニノさん！ 絆を試す3番勝負！」、番組恒例のラストゲーム「目が合ったらダメよチャレンジ」などに参加した。
detail.en: NewJeans guested on the first two-hour special in the Friday slot of Nippon TV's variety show Nino-san, hosted by Kazunari Ninomiya and aired from 7:00 to 8:54 pm, their first appearance on a Japanese variety show. Daiki Arioka (Hey! Say! JUMP) and Hikorohee joined the NewJeans block. The members showed off their individual talents and took part in the 'Capsule Talk' corner answering questions from people on the street, a three-game team battle against the Nino-san side, and the show's regular closing game, the 'don't make eye contact' challenge.

editor_note: 公式YouTube動画なし: NTV has no official Nino-san clip of NewJeans on YouTube (only news-aggregator uploads) / 2026-10-24 nightly: Nippon TV's pre-broadcast release (THE FIRST TIMES and Modelpress, 2024-11-14, photos credited Nippon TV) confirms the 11/15 (Fri) 19:00–20:54 two-hour special, NewJeans' first Japanese variety appearance, the NewJeans block guests Arioka and Hikorohee, and the corners 'Capsule Talk', 'NewJeans VSニノさん！ 絆を試す3番勝負！' and the closing game 「目が合ったらダメよチャレンジ」. Corrected the game name (was 目が合っちゃダメよ), removed the unconfirmed corner 'NewJeansの今一番気になるモノ', and qualified 'first two-hour special' as the first in the Friday 7 pm slot (per Modelpress). No official NTV video exists.

summary.ja: 第1回『Korea Grand Music Awards』初日で大賞のグランドアーティストとベストアーティスト10を受賞、ハニが司会を務め、4曲を披露。
summary.en: NewJeans won the Grand Artist Daesang and a Best Artist 10 award at the inaugural Korea Grand Music Awards, where Hanni co-hosted and the group performed four songs.

detail.ja: 仁川のINSPIREアリーナで開かれた日刊スポーツ主催の第1回『Korea Grand Music Awards』初日（アーティストデー）に、大賞のグランドアーティストと本賞のベストアーティスト10を受賞した。初日の司会はナム・ジヒョンとハニが務めた。NewJeansは「Right Now」「Bubble Gum」「How Sweet」「Supernatural」の4曲を披露し、授賞式はENAで生中継され、WavveとKisweでも配信された。
detail.en: On day one (Artist Day) of the inaugural Korea Grand Music Awards, organized by Ilgan Sports at Inspire Arena in Incheon, NewJeans won the Grand Artist (Daesang) and a Best Artist 10 award. Nam Ji-hyun and Hanni hosted day one. The group performed 'Right Now', 'Bubble Gum', 'How Sweet' and 'Supernatural'; the ceremony aired live on ENA and streamed on Wavve and Kiswe.

editor_note: 公式動画: ENA 이엔에이「[#2024KGMA] NewJeans(뉴진스) - Right now + Bubble gum + How sweet + Supernatural | #뉴진스 | ENA 241116」(2024-12-08); 関連3本をreference_urlsに記載 / 2026-10-24 nightly: Organizer Ilgan Sports' own wrap-up (isplus.com, 2024-11-16 22:13 KST) confirms the date, venue, Hanni and Nam Ji-hyun as day-one MCs and the Grand Artist award; the day-one winners list (Breaknews 2024-11-17) includes NewJeans in Best Artist 10. ENA live broadcast with Wavve and Kiswe streaming confirmed by Ilgan Sports pre-event reports. Setlist confirmed by the broadcaster's official ENA upload (-hyQdASWNnY; dateText Dec 9, 2024 KST, not Dec 8 as in the earlier note). Removed the nominations for Best Song ('Super Shy') and Trend of the Year, which were not confirmed from any source found; added broadcaster ENA to credits.

title.ja: KBS2『スーパーマンが帰ってきた』ミンジが出演
title.en: KBS2 The Return of Superman: Minji guests

summary.ja: ミンジがKBS2の育児バラエティ『スーパーマンが帰ってきた』に出演し、キム・ジュノの息子ウヌ・ジョンウ兄弟と過ごした。
summary.en: Minji guested on KBS2's parenting show The Return of Superman, spending a day with Kim Jun-ho's sons Eun-woo and Jung-woo.

detail.ja: 第550回「君を愛するのはスーパーナチュラル」編に出演し、元フェンシング代表キム・ジュノの息子ウヌ・ジョンウ兄弟に会った。ミンジにとって初の単独バラエティ出演。兄弟の映像をすべて見ているファンだと明かし、呼び方を「お姉さん」か「おばさん」かで1か月前から悩んでいたと話すと、ウヌは迷わず「お姉さん」を選んだ。
detail.en: In episode 550, titled 'Loving You Is Supernatural', Minji met Eun-woo and Jung-woo, sons of former national fencer Kim Jun-ho. It was her first solo variety appearance. She said she had watched all of the brothers' videos and had spent a month wondering whether they would call her 'big sister' or 'auntie'; Eun-woo chose 'big sister' without hesitation.

editor_note: KBS confirmed the appearance on 28 Oct 2024 (Sports Kyunghyang); broadcast date 27 Nov (Wed) and episode number 550 per Sports Donga 2024-11-26. / Source is a press report (Daum News); not confirmed against an official page. / 2026-10-24 nightly: KBS's own confirmation of the booking is quoted in Sports Kyunghyang (2024-10-28, '[공식]'); Sports Donga (2024-11-26, carried on Daum) gives the KBS 2TV broadcast on Wed Nov 27, 2024 at 20:30, episode 550 titled '너를 사랑하는 건 슈퍼내추럴', Minji's first solo variety appearance, her being a fan who had watched all the brothers' videos, the month-long 'nuna or imo' question and Eun-woo answering 'Minji nuna'. All record facts match; KBS program page itself not fetched.

title.ja: テレビ朝日『ミュージックステーション』

summary.ja: 専属契約解除の記者会見翌日、『ミュージックステーション』に5人で出演し「Ditto」「How Sweet」を披露。
summary.en: The day after their contract-termination press conference, NewJeans performed 'Ditto' and 'How Sweet' on Music Station.

detail.ja: テレビ朝日系で21時から放送された『ミュージックステーション』に5人で出演し、「Ditto」と「How Sweet」を披露した。6月21日に続く2度目の出演で、「Ditto」はこの番組で初めて披露した。前日11月28日にソウルで専属契約解除を発表する記者会見を開いた翌日の出演だった。この回にはHey! Say! JUMP、BABYMONSTER、ゴスペラーズなどが出演した。
detail.en: NewJeans appeared as a five-piece on TV Asahi's Music Station, broadcast from 9 pm, performing 'Ditto' and 'How Sweet', their second appearance on the show and the first time 'Ditto' was performed on it. It came the day after their November 28 press conference in Seoul announcing the termination of their exclusive contracts. Hey! Say! JUMP, BABYMONSTER and the Gospellers were among the other acts.

program.ja: ミュージックステーション

editor_note: 公式動画: MUSIC STATION「NewJeansの ちょっとした特技が最高すぎる【Mステ】」(2024-11-29) / 2026-10-24 nightly: TV Asahi's official MUSIC STATION YouTube channel uploaded a NewJeans clip on Nov 29, 2024 (KST, GWXmvcX27UA). Say! JUMP, BABYMONSTER, PEOPLE 1, Marcy). Oricon headlines it as their first Music Station appearance as five.

title.ja: 日本テレビ『ベストアーティスト2024』

summary.ja: 24回目となる日本テレビ『ベストアーティスト2024』に初出演し、「Supernatural」を披露。
summary.en: NewJeans' first appearance on Nippon TV's Best Artist, performing 'Supernatural' on its 24th edition.

detail.ja: 19時から22時54分まで日本テレビ系で生放送された『日テレ系音楽の祭典 ベストアーティスト2024』に出演し、21時台に「Supernatural」を披露した。2001年に始まり24回目となるこの番組への出演はこれが初めてで、出演者第1弾として11月16日に発表されていた。
detail.en: NewJeans performed 'Supernatural' in the 9 pm block of Nippon TV's live music special Best Artist 2024, broadcast from 7:00 to 10:54 pm. It was the group's first appearance on the program, which began in 2001 and was in its 24th edition; they had been announced in the first lineup on November 16.

editor_note: 公式YouTube動画なし: NTV does not publish Best Artist performances on YouTube; no official upload found / 2026-10-24 nightly: Oricon (2024-11-16, Nippon TV's first-lineup announcement) lists NewJeans among the first 16 acts for the 11/30 19:00–22:54 broadcast and states the program began in 2001 and this was its 24th edition, so '30th' in the record was wrong and was corrected to 24th. The timetable released on 2024-11-29 (Tower Records news) places NewJeans 'Supernatural' in the 21:00 block. First appearance supported by the 2023 edition's announced line-up (Anime!Anime! 2023-12-02) not including NewJeans.

summary.ja: フジテレビ『2024 FNS歌謡祭』第1夜に出演し、20時台に「How Sweet」、21時台に「Ditto」を披露。
summary.en: NewJeans performed 'How Sweet' and 'Ditto' on the first night of Fuji TV's 2024 FNS Music Festival.

detail.ja: 18時30分から23時28分までフジテレビ系で生放送された『2024 FNS歌謡祭』第1夜に出演し、タイムテーブルでは20時台に「How Sweet」、21時台に「Ditto」を披露した。司会は相葉雅紀と井上清華アナウンサー。同じ年の夏の『FNS歌謡祭 夏』に続く出演。
detail.en: NewJeans appeared on the first night of Fuji TV's 2024 FNS Music Festival, broadcast live from 6:30 to 11:28 pm, performing 'How Sweet' in the 8 pm block and 'Ditto' in the 9 pm block per the published timetable. Masaki Aiba and announcer Sayaka Inoue hosted, and the appearance followed the group's slot on the summer edition.

editor_note: 公式YouTube動画なし: Fuji TV does not publish FNS performances on YouTube; no official upload found / 2026-10-24 nightly: Fuji TV's official @fns_kayousai X post (fxtwitter, 2024-12-04 20:19 JST) thanks NewJeans for 'How Sweet' and says 'Ditto' is still to come. The day's timetable (THE FIRST TIMES, 2024-12-04) confirms Night 1 on 12/04 18:30–23:28, hosts Masaki Aiba and Sayaka Inoue, 'How Sweet' around 20:00 and 'Ditto' around 21:00. Real Sound (2024-11-20, second lineup announcement) describes NewJeans as appearing again after the summer edition.

title.ja: CBSラジオ『キム・ヒョンジョンのニュースショー』クリスマス特集
title.en: CBS Radio: Kim Hyun-jung's News Show Christmas special

summary.ja: 契約解除発表後初のトーク出演となったCBSラジオのクリスマス特集で、5人が「きよしこの夜」を歌い、ハニは自作曲を弾き語りして涙を見せた。
summary.en: In their first talk appearance since the contract announcement, the five sang 'Silent Night' on CBS Radio's Christmas special and Hanni played an original song in tears.

editor_note: Appearance during the contract dispute, after the Nov 28, 2024 termination notice; members avoided using the NewJeans name on air. | Per Mydaily and News1 (Dec 25, 2024); song title of Hanni's original per other reports (Darling, Darling) not confirmed in fetched text. / 公式YouTube動画なし: CBS Radio (Kim Hyun-jung News Show) has no official YouTube upload of the NewJeans Christmas appearance found

detail.ja: CBS標準FMの時事番組『キム・ヒョンジョンのニュースショー』のクリスマス特集に、ミンジ、ハニ、ダニエル、ヘリン、ヘインが朝に出演した。11月28日の専属契約解除の発表後、初めてのトーク番組出演で、番組側はグループ名を使わず5人の個人名で紹介した。5人は「きよしこの夜」を歌って番組を始め、ハニは自作曲をギターで弾き語りした後、メンバーが困難な時期を過ごしていると述べて涙を見せ、ヘインも涙を流した。来年の活動については「期待してほしい」と述べた。
detail.en: Minji, Hanni, Danielle, Haerin and Hyein appeared on the morning Christmas special of CBS Standard FM's current-affairs program Kim Hyun-jung's News Show, their first talk-show appearance since announcing on November 28 that they were terminating their exclusive contracts. The program introduced them by their individual names rather than the group name. The five opened by singing 'Silent Night'; Hanni performed an original song on guitar and, saying the members were going through a hard period, broke into tears, as did Hyein. Asked about the coming year, they said to look forward to it.

summary.ja: 『2024 Asia Artist Awards』で3年連続の大賞となる今年の歌手賞など3冠、3曲を披露。
summary.en: NewJeans took a third straight AAA Daesang, Singer of the Year, plus two more awards in Bangkok, performing three songs.

detail.ja: タイ・バンコクのインパクト・チャレンジャーホールで開かれた『2024 Asia Artist Awards』で、大賞の今年の歌手賞、ベストアーティスト賞、ベストパフォーマンス賞を受賞した。大賞受賞は3年連続。ステージでは「Bubble Gum」「Supernatural」「How Sweet」を披露。司会はリュ・ジュンヨル、チャン・ウォニョン、ソン・ハンビンで、韓国ではMTN、世界ではWeverse、日本ではU-NEXTが配信した。
detail.en: At the 2024 Asia Artist Awards at Impact Challenger Hall in Bangkok, NewJeans won the Singer of the Year grand prize, their third consecutive AAA Daesang, plus the Best Artist Award and the Best Performance Award, and performed 'Bubble Gum', 'Supernatural' and 'How Sweet'. Ryu Jun-yeol, Jang Won-young and Sung Han-bin hosted; the show aired on MTN in Korea, Weverse worldwide and U-NEXT in Japan.

title.ja: 日本テレビ『発表！今年イチバン聴いた歌〜年間ミュージックアワード2024〜』
title.en: NTV: Most-Listened Song of the Year 2024

summary.ja: 日本テレビ系の年間ミュージックアワード特番に3年連続で出演し、21時台の枠に編成された。
summary.en: NewJeans' third straight year on Nippon TV's year-end music award special, scheduled in the 9 pm block.

detail.ja: 千葉・ホテルニューオータニ幕張から19時から22時54分まで日本テレビ系で生放送された『発表！今年イチバン聴いた歌～年間ミュージックアワード2024～』に3年連続で出演した。MCは上白石萌音と池田エライザ。サブスクのランキングデータをもとに今年最も聴かれた曲・アーティストを発表する番組で、NewJeansは21時台の枠に編成された。
detail.en: NewJeans appeared for a third consecutive year on Nippon TV's live year-end special Happyo! Kotoshi Ichiban Kiita Uta: Nenkan Music Award 2024, broadcast from 7:00 to 10:54 pm from Hotel New Otani Makuhari in Chiba and hosted by Mone Kamishiraishi and Elaiza Ikeda. title.ja: 第66回輝く!日本レコード大賞

summary.ja: 『第66回輝く！日本レコード大賞』で「Supernatural」が2年連続の優秀作品賞を受賞、チェジュ航空機事故を悼む黒いリボンを付けて同曲を披露。
summary.en: 'Supernatural' won NewJeans a second straight Excellent Work Award at the 66th Japan Record Awards, performed while wearing black mourning ribbons for the Jeju Air crash.

detail.ja: 東京・新国立劇場で開かれた『第66回輝く！日本レコード大賞』で、日本デビュー曲「Supernatural」により2年連続の優秀作品賞を受賞し、同曲を披露した。前日12月29日に務安国際空港で起きたチェジュ航空機事故を受け、メンバーは襟に黒いリボンを付けて出演した。パフォーマンス前のトークでは、ヘリンが最近覚えた日本語として「右・左」を挙げた。TBS系で17時30分から22時まで生放送され、総合司会は安住紳一郎と川口春奈。
detail.en: At the 66th Japan Record Awards at the New National Theatre in Tokyo, NewJeans received the Excellent Work Award for their Japanese debut single 'Supernatural', their second consecutive year, and performed the song. Following the Jeju Air crash at Muan International Airport the day before, December 29, the members appeared with black mourning ribbons on their collars. In the talk before the performance, Haerin said the Japanese words she had recently learned were 'migi' and 'hidari' (right and left). TBS broadcast the ceremony live from 5:30 to 10:00 pm, hosted by Shinichiro Azumi and Haruna Kawaguchi.

They performed on day one, January 4, with an intro, 'Supernatural' (Attention mix) and 'How Sweet'. Sung Si-kyung, Cha Eun-woo and Moon Ga-young hosted. After the Jeju Air crash, JTBC's live broadcast was replaced by a recorded airing on January 6 and 7.

detail.ja: 『2024 MBC歌謡大祭典 WANNABE』は当初2024年12月31日の生放送が予定されていたが、チェジュ航空機事故による国家哀悼期間を受けて録画放送に切り替えられ、1月29日に第1部、30日に第2部が旧正月連休に放送された。司会はユナ（少女時代）、ミンホ（SHINee）、ドフン（TWS）。NewJeansは第1部の序盤、IVE、(G)I-DLEとともに「ワナビー」スターたちのデビュー曲を披露するブロックで「Attention」を歌い、グループ名「NewJeans」で紹介され、ステージにもグループ名が掲げられた。同じ第1部では「Right Now（Jazz ver.）」「How Sweet」「Hurt」のステージも放送された。
detail.en: The 2024 MBC Gayo Daejejeon WANNABE, originally scheduled for live broadcast on December 31, 2024, was switched to a recorded broadcast because of the national mourning period after the Jeju Air crash, airing in two parts on January 29 and 30 during the Lunar New Year holiday, hosted by Yoona (Girls' Generation), Minho (Shinee) and Dohoon (TWS). Early in part 1, in a block of debut-song stages by 'wannabe' stars NewJeans, Ive and (G)I-dle, NewJeans performed 'Attention'; they were introduced as NewJeans and the group name was displayed on the stage. Part 1 also featured their stages of 'Right Now' (Jazz ver.), 'How Sweet' and 'Hurt'.

detail.ja: メンバー5人がCNN（CNN Style、記者オスカー・ホランド）の独占インタビューで新しいグループ名「NJZ」を発表した。ハニは改名を困難な時期をより前向きなものに変える方法と説明し、元の名前の本質を残したと述べ、ダニエルはファンの提案を長い時間をかけて検討したと語った。3月に香港のComplexConで新名義での初ステージと新曲の披露を予定していると明かした。ADORは同じ日、法的判断前の一方的な名称の発表は専属契約の重大な違反となり得るとの声明を出した。
detail.en: The five members announced their new group name NJZ in an exclusive interview with CNN (CNN Style, by Oscar Holland). Hanni described the renaming as a way of turning a rough period into something more exciting and said it kept the essence of the original name, while Danielle said the group had spent a long time weighing fan suggestions. They said they would perform under the new name for the first time and debut a new song at ComplexCon Hong Kong in March. ADOR responded the same day that announcing an unauthorized name before a legal ruling could constitute a material breach of the exclusive contract.
